### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report only patient-stated symptoms; do not infer or add unmentioned complaints.
[A/P-Section]: Accurately reflect the provider's stated actions and commitments; do not alter the certainty or intent of their statements.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report only patient-stated symptoms; do not infer or add unmentioned complaints.
[A/P-Section]: Accurately reflect the provider's stated actions and commitments; do not alter the certainty or intent of their statements, particularly for future plans (e.g., 'will refer' must not be softened to 'consider referring').

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report only patient-stated symptoms; do not infer, add unmentioned complaints, or include symptoms explicitly denied by the patient.
[A/P-Section]: Accurately reflect the provider's stated actions, commitments, and trigger conditions; do not alter the certainty, intent, or specific conditions of their statements.
